purpose: Prevent narrow local PASS receipts from being mistaken for full N0 sufficiency. Every historical weakness must have an explicit successor proof, and unresolved runtime/behavioral proofs block gradient or closure.

obligations.requirement: New stack is independent successor wiring; historical PASS weights do not silently define runtime semantics.
All historical N0 PASS/qualified artifacts are non-authoritative by default; only explicitly scoped initialization/regression/data carry-forwards may enter the successor.
The actual shared backbone interface exposes every hidden layer and preserves gradient connectivity instead of reintroducing pooled/final-layer authority.
Relation/factor cardinality are runtime axes, not checkpoint semantic axes.
Relation candidate ordering cannot encode meaning.
Factor candidate ordering cannot encode meaning.
Variable runtime schema subsets work in one batch.
Variable runtime factor-schema subsets work per example in one batch; padded factor candidates cannot become hidden semantic authority.
Padding inactive candidates cannot fake confidence or uncertainty.
Runtime factor-bank set order is not semantic.
Open semantic factors affect continuous semantics even when not mapped to fixed executor opcodes.
Finite runtime step budget cannot silently masquerade as completed reasoning.
Semantic backbone can co-adapt; temporary frozen parent is not permanent architecture.
Structured fields are permutation-safe and use runtime semantic descriptors.
Structured field set attention uses exact streaming softmax with dense-equivalent outputs/gradients while never materializing the full field-pair score matrix.
Adding descriptor banks cannot change representation merely by count scaling.
No global task-agnostic layer mixture erases relation/query-specific intermediate-layer signal.
Raw semantic fusion view must not reintroduce a static all-layer mean that erases task-relevant intermediate-layer signal.
Probability-like structured confidence/missingness metadata fails closed outside [0,1] instead of silently steering semantics.
Graph relation identity comes from runtime schema states, not fixed learned relation IDs.
Symmetric relation storage orientation cannot change graph semantics.
Non-relational/deferred programs cannot contaminate graph views.
Empty graphs cannot fabricate evidence summaries.
Evidence specialization uses multilayer tokens and no relation-ID axis.
Inactive relation schemas cannot steer evidence specialization.
Binder supports exact zero evidence even when distractor edges are structurally valid.
Runtime relation symmetry is respected by exact type compatibility.
LOCAL/PATH/AGGREGATE have distinct continuous execution semantics.
Mixed-step direction is noncommutative and step-local.
Multi-hop path length cannot inflate relational execution confidence by summing recurrent survival mass; confidence is governed by exact joint completed relational-program probability.
Symmetric relation behavior is endpoint-storage invariant.
Truncated reasoning cannot claim completed relational confidence.
No-support means no relational execution result.
Binder/executor support and evidence quality metadata cannot exceed their probability contracts.
Runtime view ordering is not semantic and exact source anchors survive contextualization.
Fusion reliability metadata must be finite and inside [0,1].
Slot/view counts are runtime axes, not checkpoint capability ceilings.
Latent result is invariant to unordered runtime view permutation.
Latent slot-item competition is exact under chunked streaming and does not require a full slot-by-view score matrix.
Runtime view reliability must causally alter latent evidence contribution; it cannot cancel as a constant inside the wrong softmax axis.
Changing requested slot count does not redefine existing slot coordinates arbitrarily.
Full stack admits runtime expansion of views/slots/steps without new learned identities.
Native encoder window is an operating window, not a product context ceiling.
Long-query segmentation preserves unique token order without overlap duplication.
Overlapping long-context windows use balanced ownership rather than systematically retaining boundary tokens from the context-poor later window.
Global cross-window semantic interaction cannot depend on arbitrary segment enumeration when continuous position metadata moves with the segment.
Training signal from one native window can reach semantic states in another window through the bridge.
Cross-window bridge has no learned segment identity or segment-count parameter axis and uses memory-bounded global segment attention.
Token-lossless segmentation may not be misrepresented as standalone globally contextualized semantics.
Short semantic items preserve all backbone hidden layers through the unified input path.
Relation, factor, and descriptor semantics can exceed the native encoder window without introducing a product token ceiling.
Padded fields and candidates remain exactly inert under the universal semantic input path.
Long semantic surfaces preserve joint gradient connectivity through the shared backbone and cross-window bridge.
No text-bearing N0 surface relies on the native encoder window as a declared product capability ceiling.
Memory-bounded token interaction is mathematically equivalent to dense interaction.
Padded runtime fields are inert rather than errors or false evidence.
Full fabric can train against behavioral labels without self-referential parent-embedding reconstruction.
Operator objective directly supervises behaviorally meaningful relation/factor/control/evidence states.
Large-magnitude losses cannot silently dominate and task authority is not learned from TEST results.

Natural human-annotated relation families use 56 TRAIN / 8 DEV from official train_wiki and all 16 official val_wiki relation families as the untouched public natural final benchmark, with final descriptions absent from TRAIN/DEV.
Synthetic interventions supplement natural data and are leakage-audited.

The exact CPU runtime fixture and fail-closed runner must pass static shape, schema, padding, edge, factor, no-gradient authorization, dedicated long-context-fixture, and every text-bearing semantic-surface virtualization checks before Magnolia execution.
Final public judgment gradient must reach the shared semantic backbone and trainable cross-window bridge through the same topology intended for optimization.
Historical public semantic replay and full-envelope behavioral training must co-adapt the same registered semantic backbone parameters rather than detached copies.
Exact registered training topology must have closed parameter accounting and no learned runtime-cardinality or product-context ceiling.
Optional additional semantic banks may be entirely unavailable without inventing fake semantic content or making valid examples fail.
Every public-N0 optimization component is assigned once to a precommitted macro family with no learned or TEST-adaptive task weighting.
The integrated joint objective propagates gradient through the shared backbone, semantic operator, Binder null-support boundary, fusion router, public judgment probe, and long-context bridge.
UNKNOWN/DEFER or other rows with no active relational comparison cannot create NaN causal-margin losses.
Materialized behavioral rows compile into primary, decisive-ablation, irrelevant-removal and exact field-permutation variants without semantic use of opaque metadata keys.
Compiled behavioral batches execute through the registered system and integrated objective on every causal path with gradient reaching the shared semantic backbone and structural judgment path.
Positive support targets are structurally valid and UNKNOWN/DEFER rows supervise explicit null support with inactive endpoint sentinels.

Generated public behavioral fabric passes entity/query/field/candidate surface isolation, semantic-key leakage, exact scenario-family contract coverage, criterion-neutral structural Binder support targets, support/endpoint consistency, intervention and runtime-axis audits before any gradient.
Anti-collapse supervision must detect rank-one collapse even when duplicated slots flip sign rather than align positively.
Irrelevant-view invariance must remain backward-finite when padded candidate probabilities underflow to exact zero.
Gradient accumulation topology must not change macro-family loss scaling within an effective optimizer step when EMA scales are frozen.
Macro-family EMA scales must support one detached effective-batch update rather than one update per microbatch.

Exact tokenizer must pass byte-fallback/OOV, Unicode normalization, heldout relation/factor description fragmentation, long entity, punctuation/code/math and multilingual tokenization stress; failure reopens tokenizer.

Exact v0.2.1 tokenizer must convert every governed synthetic query/relation/factor/step-factor evidence char span into nonempty token targets without truncation loss; the 512-token audit length is an operating point, not a product ceiling.
Materialized broad public replay corpus must reverify exact hashes/licenses/source balance and must not be treated as operator-complete without natural/intervention lanes.

Exact 640-wide successor plus the ratified semantic initialization must construct and complete an end-to-end CPU inference-mode forward on representative variable-cardinality inputs, with exact parameter counts, finite-output checks, and peak-RSS receipt. Gradient connectivity is proven separately by exact static mechanics tests; this CPU gate performs no gradient.

Exact full training topology must pass a GPU no-gradient memory dry run before any gradient or optimizer authorization. The dry run chooses a safe sharding/microbatch/accumulation route; it may not update weights.
Joint training must fit behavioral objectives without broad semantic regression or shortcut leakage.
DEV must pass unseen relation families, factor combinations, compositions, cardinality extrapolation, long-context relevance and causal interventions.
Frozen final-v2 behavioral package must pass every gate; semantic cosine or historical PASS cannot independently authorize N0 closure.
Query-conditioned fusion relevance must causally control how views contribute to the latent fabric; reliability alone is not relevance.
Final public judgment gradient must reach the fusion route scorer through the latent path.
Merely available irrelevant views are not compulsory latent recoverability targets.
Padded structured fields and arbitrary hidden values behind their masks cannot alter valid field states or pooled context.
Ordered execution must consume the relation semantic state for the current operator step; averaging relation semantic states across the program may not own executable edge meaning.

Holding evidence, direction, traversal and learned readout preference fixed, changing only ROLE_SOURCE versus ROLE_TARGET must causally switch the executor structural endpoint readout and final relational probability.
Graph source/target views can activate only from relation probability mass represented by valid runtime edges; duplicate edges may not inflate that mass.
Whole-program relation state must be aggregated using actual survival-weighted relation assignment mass, while exact step-conditioned relation states remain preserved.
Shared query/schema interaction must expose masked token-local evidence on both query and schema sides for relations, global factors, and step-conditioned factors.
Schema-token grounding loss must keep a live gradient path into shared query/backbone semantics.
Query/schema evidence surfaces share the existing token-grounding macro budget so adding banks cannot silently dominate optimization.
Partial schema-evidence supervision inputs fail closed.
Synthetic operator rows must materialize exact query, relation-schema, factor-schema, and step-factor-schema evidence spans and pass split/leakage audit.
Type-incompatible relation edges are exactly excluded before continuous graph propagation and cannot contaminate structured/evidence state before Binder.
Binder null support must prevent graph source/target summaries from entering final fusion even when a soft pre-Binder graph was active.

Binder sparse support must represent structurally/semantically relevant candidate support and remain neutral to reliability/recency arbitration so one global support set cannot violate later step-local modifier semantics.

Reliability, recency, temporal, and provenance edge scalars must be neutralized before executor edge-state construction whenever the corresponding semantic modifier is OFF, while ON retains sensitivity.

Global graph and evidence-specialist views must keep explicit reliability/recency/temporal/provenance criterion channels neutral because one global view cannot represent conflicting step-local ON/OFF semantics; raw criterion values remain available to the step-conditioned Executor.
A candidate marked invalid by candidate_valid_mask is structurally impossible and may never outrank a valid candidate regardless of learned logit magnitude.
Padded candidates must be exactly excluded from public-judgment normalization and gradients; with one valid candidate the classification loss is exactly zero regardless of padded logits.

When a causal behavioral lane is inactive, exact padded-candidate exclusion may not create -inf×0/NaN zero losses; zero-return paths must depend only on valid logits and padded candidates must receive exactly zero gradient.
Structural masks must preserve probability mass on valid entries even when valid learned logits are far below legacy finite sentinels; explicitly permitted empty slices must return exact zero mass.
An inactive semantic relation/factor candidate may never receive probability or erase an active candidate merely because learned active logits cross a finite masking sentinel.
An unavailable runtime view may never receive fusion mass or erase available-view mass when learned route logits take extreme finite values.

When one relation is reused across steps and reliability is ON for an earlier step but OFF for a later step, Binder's global sparse support may not let the earlier criterion alter the later step's edge eligibility.
A mixed-step program with reliability ON then OFF must not let a global graph/evidence view apply the global criterion to both steps; explicit global criterion channels remain neutral.

Additional runtime views, descriptors, availability, and reliability may be permuted together without changing fused state, latent pooled state, or public judgment; runtime view position is not a hidden semantic identity axis.
Runtime candidate ordering is not semantic: jointly permuting candidate states and masks must only permute candidate logits, with no candidate-position identity parameter or bias.

Role, traversal and control remain deliberate whole-program executable semantics while direction and evidence modifiers are step-local. Step-factor semantic context may include every runtime bank, but copied role/traversal/control step labels must not silently create unsupported structural opcodes.

Candidate text is comparison material rather than an independent policy: when the governed latent judgment signal is removed, distinct candidate content may not create candidate-specific ranking logits. Every candidate-specific final-readout feature must contain latent interaction.

Binder supervision must encode query-relevant structural/semantic support, not relation-key equality. Same-relation irrelevant edges remain hard negatives, while query-relevant reliability/recency/temporal/provenance alternatives survive Binder for step-local Executor arbitration.

The current full-envelope successor must have an executable pre-gradient shortcut audit registered in CI for every shortcut probe declared by the semantic/operator curriculum contract. Superseded T2 shortcut receipts cannot satisfy this obligation.

The behavioral curriculum must include matched rows with identical query and candidate-answer set/order but different evidence-conditioned public targets, so candidate wording cannot be a stable shortcut for final judgment.

Residual CONTINUE survival after the final available reasoning slot is truncation, not successful relational completion. A truncated program may not activate graph/evidence relational views; global semantic relational activity must require completion just as Executor confidence does.

Before gradient, the full-envelope successor must define its own sealed final-v2 package builder/auditor/freezer and evaluator contract targeting N0FullEnvelopeTrainableSystemV1. Legacy final-self-validation v1/v3 artifacts may not satisfy or be promoted into successor final-v2 authority.

Before gradient, successor final-v2 natural and adversarial synthetic artifacts must be materialized, audited for TRAIN/DEV independence and extrapolation coverage, and hash-frozen without observing any candidate model result or authorizing final opening.

Relational completion must use the exact joint survival/event mass. Marginal P(program starts) multiplied by marginal P(not truncated/unknown) may not fabricate graph/evidence activity when start and completion occur on disjoint branches.
Executor confidence must be zero when no probability mass both starts a relational program and subsequently reaches STOP, even if P(start)>0 and P(not truncated)>0 separately.

Global relation semantics for an asserted completed program must be conditioned on branches that later reach STOP. Relation distributions from branches that only continue to UNKNOWN/truncation may not contaminate the completed graph/evidence program summary.

Executor path state used for completed relational output must be conditioned on successful future STOP completion. Relation steps that exist only on branches ending in truncation/UNKNOWN may not move the completed-program frontier.

Before gradient, N0 must have an executable public TRAIN/DEV long-context supplement, separate from FINAL, that places decisive semantic content beyond the native-window operating point across query, relation schema, factor schema, type schema, field text, field descriptor, candidate text, and internal view descriptor surfaces. CPU smoke coverage or FINAL-only long rows cannot satisfy this training-curriculum obligation.
